About the project 
 We are looking for a Python Developer to join our Accounting & HR Department. You will support us with developing and implementing of small and medium systems in an agile set-up.
 Discover Raiffeisen Tech 
 ✨Raiffeisen Tech Romania, a subsidiary of Raiffeisen Tech GmbH in Vienna, brings together experienced tech talents to enable Raiffeisen Bank International (RBI) Group to deliver innovative digital solutions. We work on international, enterprise‑grade projects using modern technologies, fostering collaboration, curiosity, and continuous learning . 
 Your mission 🎯
Be a value-adding enabler for our agile product team, supporting DevOpsSec way of working
Work with cross-functional teams to developer and implement small to medium system changes and continuous improvements
Conduct validation tests, migrations, and participate in User Acceptance Testing
Integrate new data sources and ensure their maintenance
Provide support to end-users
Work collaboratively - sharing knowledge and helping teammates in your areas of expertise
 Required superpowers 💪
Minimum of 2 years’ experience in operating and developing software solutions with Python/Django
Experience with databases (SQL)
Professional experience with cloud computing with AWS, e.g. EC2/AWS based Linux, S3, or AWS Lambda
Understanding importance of security in development and operations
Affinity for IT processes and IT lifecycle management
Experience with Agile, SCRUM or Kanban
Analytical, result-oriented and structured way of working
Proficiency in English
 Nice to have ✨
Terraform/CloudFormation experience
